content.title: Pagaya, Castlelake reach deal for up to $500 million in auto loans
content.summary: Lending platform Pagaya Technologies on Monday announced an agreement to sell up to $500 million of its auto loans to asset-based private credit manager Castlelake. In a statement, New York City-based Pagaya said the deal "has the potential to significantly accelerate Pagaya's auto lending platform." The firms reached a forward flow agreement, whereby Minneapolis-based Castlelake has agreed to buy auto loans from Pagaya in the future for immediate capital payment.
